build_SELayer_default: build a Squeeze-and-Excitation layer with default ratio 16 and ReLU-Sigmoid activations for channel attention
build_SELayer_custom_squeeze: build an SE layer with custom squeeze_channels to control bottleneck dimension explicitly
build_SELayer_return_weight: build an SE layer that returns attention weights instead of applying them to input
test_SELayer_forward: test the SELayer forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying spatial attention output
review_SELayer_init: review the SELayer constructor to understand channel squeezing via ratio and divisor parameters
